Case EVAL0044 has no AWARD event in the full provided timeline (only PUBLICATION on 2026-09-14 and CONTRACT-END on 2026-09-19).
detailed_results.explanation: Regulation R12_CONTRACT_END_REQUIRES_AWARD requires that if a contract ends (termination/contract end), an award must have existed before that contract end; a contract end without an award is prohibited. In the provided complete log for case_id EVAL0044, there is a CONTRACT-END event dated 2026-09-19, but there is no AWARD event at any time in the case timeline (award_count = 0). Because the logs are sufficient to determine that a contract end occurred and that no award is recorded before it (or at all), the case conflicts with the regulation and is therefore NON_COMPLIANT.
